messages:
jamie.ops: incident-bot alerted: multiple streaming requests started failing with CUDA OOM on decode nodes, customer-visible drops. paging oncall.

oncall-bot: @lee-sre you are oncall for infra this shift — paging now.

lee-sre: seeing a flood of OOMs on decode-pool-3, GPU memory at 100% and containers restarting. stack traces show 'CUDA out of memory' inside decode loop.

devin-runtime: logs show the generated sequence lengths spiked — some requests hitting max_tokens unset by client (defaulted to huge) -> runaway generation. batching also amplified memory per-request.

sasha-ml: which model variant? any quantization turned off?

devin-runtime: most affected are v2-decoder (fp16) instances on A100s in eu-west-1. Quantized variants had fewer failures but routing fallback didn't trigger fast enough.

maria-support: support queue: multiple customers (ID# 1982, 2103) reported partial responses / dropped streams. One customer has a high SLA and is escalating.

jamie.ops: quick customer impact calc: request drop rate jumped from 0.1% -> 3.4% in last 10m for streaming endpoints. affected tenants ~12 (top 3 by requests: finance-ops, chatbotx, docs-qa).

lee-sre: immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle/limit max_tokens at proxy to 1024 for streaming endpoints; 2) force-route streaming to quantized fallback pool; 3) roll back recent routing policy change that increased batch sizes.

devin-runtime: I can push a proxy config to inject a top-level tokens cap. will take ~5m to converge. downside: truncation for some users.

sasha-ml: recommended: throttle now + trigger fallback routing gradually. Also add a short-term KV prefix cache flush? might help with memory pressure? not sure.

lee-sre: KV cache flush could actually free some memory on long-running sessions, but main culprit is unbounded decode allocations. do throttling first.

jamie.ops: agreed. @devin-runtime please push token cap to 1024 and set hard reject policy for requests with client max_tokens > 1024 (respond 400 with explanatory message).

devin-runtime: pushing patch to gateway config: set streaming.max_tokens_enforce=1024, mode=reject-excess. deploying now.

incident-bot: deployment started by devin-runtime (cfg/streaming/2026-03-15/force-token-cap). CI green.

lee-sre: I'm scaling up quantized-fallback pool by +30% to absorb routing shifts. doing a rolling scale on dedicated nodes.

maria-support: sending proactive message to top-affected customers that we're mitigating and: "if you relied on very long generations, expect truncation until stable" — ok to proceed?

jamie.ops: yes, send now. include workaround: set client-side max_tokens if they need longer, and we can provision dedicated capacity.

devin-runtime: config deployed, gateway reports policy active. starting to see reduction in OOM logs. GPU mem pressure dropping on decode-pool-3.

lee-sre: routing moved ~60% of streaming to quantized-fallback pool. error rate back to ~0.6% — still elevated but improving.

sasha-ml: can we add a short-term safety in the runtime to cap per-request KV cache size and abort requests that allocate beyond X MB? helps prevent single-request blast.

devin-runtime: I can add guardrail to runtime decoder: per-request allocation cap of 6GB, abort w/ 500 and structured error. will take ~15-20m to roll safely.

jamie.ops: okay do it after we stabilize. next steps: monitor for 30m, then decide on permanent fix: API default max_tokens=1024 or better client validation plus transparent docs.

maria-support: ticket updates sent. customer finance-ops escalated to their CSM; they accepted workaround for now.

lee-sre: final note: found in node logs some container OOM kills due to CUDA driver complaining "out of memory" then processes hung and k8s restarted them. filing a bug about better fallback when decode kernel fails (avoid global PID-reuse causing extra pressure).

jamie.ops: kudos to everyone. I'll open a postmortem draft: "streaming unbounded-generation -> GPU OOM -> request drops; mitigated by gateway token cap + fallback routing". assign owners: postmortem lead: jamie.ops, runtime action: devin-runtime, routing: lee-sre, customer comms: maria-support, ML policy: sasha-ml.

incident-bot: incident severity set to SEV2, pager closed for now.

lee-sre: leaving a small follow-up: we should instrument per-request allocation metrics into tracing so we can alert before OOM. created ticket INFRA-2743.

jamie.ops: last check: error rate back under 0.5% across streaming endpoints. moving to monitoring. closing thread in 1hr unless regressions. :white_check_mark:
